jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner - Pediatric Critical Care
jobs.summary: Acute care PNP role on the 12-bed PICU at Barbara Bush Children's Hospital, working with intensivists and fellows. Covers medical, surgical and post-op cardiac patients. Relocation assistance and a sign-on bonus are offered.
jobs.description:
Barbara Bush Children's Hospital at Maine Medical Center is seeking a Nurse Practitioner to join our Pediatric Critical Care team.

The PICU Nurse Practitioner provides direct patient care to critically ill infants, children and adolescents in collaboration with the pediatric intensivist. Responsibilities include admission history and physicals, daily progress notes, procedures within scope, family meetings, and coordination with consulting services.

Schedule: 12-hour shifts, rotating days and nights, with one weekend in three.

Why MaineHealth:
- Relocation assistance up to $10,000
- $15,000 sign-on bonus
- Continuing education allowance
- Tuition support

MaineHealth is an equal opportunity employer.
requirements: Master's or DNP from an accredited NP program
2 years pediatric critical care RN or NP experience preferred
Active RN and APRN/NP license (or eligible) in the state
jobs.relevance_reason: Explicitly a pediatric acute care NP role in a PICU.
